sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a low, fast assassin's run, leaning far forward, the cloak streaming behind, the near arm and its blade held low ahead, the LEGS STEPPING IN TURN
sheets.weapons: THE WRIST BLADE AND THE CLOAK go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): where the pale figure shows a long grey blade from his NEAR FIST, draw it there - one long, straight, single-edged SILVER BLADE held in the near hand, as long as his forearm, in the steel colours of the design; where it shows none, draw the bare blue-violet fist as the design. The rust-red CLOAK with its silver BLADE TIPS and the LONG SPEAR TIP at its lower end streams, swirls and lies as the pale figure's does. Only these: no thrown blades in the air, no blade trails.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: the legs exactly as the pale figure: one foot planted, the other lifted or swinging. The two legs TAKE TURNS frame by frame as the pale figures show - never the same leg pose in every frame, never both legs stretched apart in every frame; the body bobs with the steps.

sheets.weapons: THE WRIST BLADE AND THE CLOAK go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): where the pale figure shows a long grey blade from his NEAR FIST, draw it there - one long, straight, single-edged SILVER BLADE held in the near hand, as long as his forearm, in the steel colours of the design; where it shows none, draw the bare blue-violet fist as the design. The rust-red CLOAK with its silver BLADE TIPS and the LONG SPEAR TIP at its lower end streams, swirls and lies as the pale figure's does. Only these: no thrown blades in the air, no blade trails.
